annotations.title: MCP server check, inspector: tools, auth and protocol

description: Inspect a remote MCP server over streamable HTTP: whether it answers initialize, its name, version, protocol version and capabilities, whether it needs sign-in (OAuth or another 401 challenge), and its tools with names, titles, descriptions and input parameters, plus prompt and resource counts. Read-only: it lists, never calls a tool. Use to vet an MCP server before adding it to an agent, or to check your own after a deploy. Example: url=https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
